description: WhatsApp is adding a new privacy-focused mode for Meta AI that is designed for conversations users may not want to keep or share. The feature creates a temporary chat that deletes itself after use and does not retain context for future responses. Meta says the underlying system also conceals identifying details, such as a user's IP address, while processing requests. WhatsApp will also introduce a Side Chat feature later that can provide private AI assistance within existing conversations.
title: WhatsApp Introduces Incognito Chat With Meta AI for Private Conversations

description: The Sun unleashed an M5.7-class Solar Flare on May 10, 2026, disrupting high-frequency radio communications and launching a coronal mass ejection toward Earth. Scientists predict the incoming plasma could trigger a minor geomagnetic storm and brighten auroras across northern regions. The event highlights the Sun’s increasing activity as it approaches the peak of its 11-year solar cycle this year.
title: Sun Erupts with Powerful Solar Flare, Sending Plasma Toward Earth

description: Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026) key specifications have been revealed ahead of launch on May 19. It is confirmed to come with a Q10 AMOLED LTPO display with 3K resolution and up to 144Hz refresh rate. It will run on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and an 8,000mAh battery with 90W fast charging support. The new phone will have triple rear cameras. The company is currently taking pre-orders for the upcoming gaming-focused smartphone.
title: Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026) Key Specifications Teased; Confirmed to Feature Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 8,000mAh Battery

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide, the South Korean tech conglomerate’s first rumoured wide-folding handset, will carry a dual rear camera system, according to a report. The foldable will reportedly boast a 50-megapixel primary camera on the back with an f/1.8 aperture, paired with an ultrawide camera featuring an f/1.9 aperture. For selfies and video calls, the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide will reportedly boast two 10-megapixel cameras, one placed on the cover display and the other appearing on the foldable screen. It will reportedly be available for purchase in at least a Dark Green colourway, which is said to be the “signature” colour option.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide Leak Hints at Dual Rear Camera Setup, New Signature Colourway

description: DeFi mobile aggregator Legend has announced that it will shut down operations after two years. The protocol said the app will continue running for 60 days before going offline on July 12.
title: DeFi Aggregator Legend to Shut Down Operations After Two Years

description: Moto Tag 2 is now available for purchase in select international markets in two different colour options. The Moto Tag 2 supports Ultra-Wideband (UWB) tracking and offers Bluetooth channel sounding technology. It is advertised to offer over 600 days of battery life on a single charge. The Moto Tag 2 was launched during CES 2026 earlier this year.
title: Moto Tag 2 With UWB Tracking, Over 600 Days of Battery Life Launched in Select Markets

description: Apple is reportedly planning major changes for iOS 27, including a customisable Camera app and a redesigned Siri experience. Users may be able to choose which camera controls appear on screen and where they are placed. Siri could gain a new Dynamic Island interface, a dedicated app, and web search capabilities. Apple is also expected to update Safari, Weather, and Image Playground, while refining system animations and tab bars. The company is likely to unveil iOS 27 at WWDC on June 8.
title: Apple Reportedly Plans to Unveil Camera App With Modifiable Controls, Revamped Siri App at WWDC 2026

description: Qualcomm's Deepu John on how Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 and 4 Gen 5 will redefine the mainstream smartphone category in India this year.
title: Qualcomm’s Deepu John on How Snapdragon 6 Gen and 4 Gen 5 Will Redefine Mainstream Smartphones in India

description: Motorola may have arrived late to the book-style foldable segment, but the company believes timing matters more than speed. In an exclusive interaction, Shivam Ranjan, Marketing Head – APAC, explains why the Razr Fold could become Motorola’s biggest premium play yet, how it plans to compete with other players, and why foldables are finally entering a more mature phase.
title: This is an Offer You Can’t Refuse: Shivam Ranjan on Motorola’s Big Razr Fold Bet

description: The iQOO 15T is all set to be launched in China next week, the company announced on Wednesday. It is expected to join the brand’s flagship lineup, which already comprises the iQOO 15 and iQOO 15 Ultra. Ahead of its anticipated debut, iQOO has also revealed several key specifications of the 15T. It is confirmed to sport a 6.82-inch display with a 2K resolution. The brand says iQOO 15T will become the first smartphone globally to launch with the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Monster Edition chipset.
title: iQOO 15T Launch Date, Key Specifications Announced as Company Reveals Design

description: The Man with the Bag is a festive adventure comedy directed by Adam Shankman. Starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and Alan Ritchson, the film follows Santa Claus teaming up with a former thief to recover a stolen magical bag. The movie promises humor, action, emotional moments, and Christmas entertainment.
title: The Man with the Bag OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch This Christmas Comedy Film Online?

description: Spotify has updated its website and mobile app to remove its most affordable Premium subscription plan in India. Dubbed Spotify Premium Lite, the plan was introduced in November 2025 at a monthly subscription fee of Rs. 139.  It offered “high audio quality” music streaming at up to 160 kbps, while also providing an ad-free experience, available only for a single account. Along with this, the company has also updated its platform to reflect the new prices for the remaining Spotify Premium subscription plans.
title: Spotify Premium Prices Revised in India, Spotify Lite Plan Seemingly Discontinued Six Months After Launch

description: JPMorgan plans to launch the OnChain Liquidity-Token Money Market Fund on Ethereum for stablecoin issuers. The fund, managed by Kinexys Digital Assets, will invest in Treasury bills and overnight repurchase agreements secured by US Treasurys or cash.
title: JPMorgan Plans to Launch Tokenised Money Market Fund on Ethereum for Stablecoin Issuers

The teaser video shows over-ear headphones with a redesigned metallic hinge, matching leaked renders of the rumoured The ColleXion Headphones. The upcoming model is tipped to feature leather or vegan leather ear cups, a MediaTek MT2855 chipset, Sony's QN3 processor, and DSEE Ultimate audio upscaling. The headphones may launch in black and white colour options and are expected to cost $649 (roughly Rs. 55,000).
title: Sony Teases Launch of New Headset Ahead of Anticipated Debut of 'The ColleXion Headphones'

The new foldable flagship lineup is likely to be launched alongside a new Galaxy “Fold Wide" smartphone and Samsung Smart Glasses. The event could take place in London on July 22.

title: Kaalidas 2 Now Streaming on Prime Video, Lionsgate Play India, and More: Know Everything About Plot, Cast, and More

If you are in the market for a new AC this summer season, when temperatures have reached 44 degrees Celsius, you can buy one during the ongoing sale event to maximise your savings. The Amazon Great Summer Sale is giving you the opportunity to save up to Rs. 54,000. For reference, you can get a Daikin 0.8 ton split AC with a 2-Star energy efficiency rating at a discounted price of Rs. 26,490. title: Amazon Great Summer Sale: Best Deals on Air Conditioners From Lloyd, IFB, Daikin and More

description: Vivo Y60 has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company’s Y lineup. The handset is currently on sale in the country via Vivo’s online store. It is offered in Lucky Purple, Obsidian Black, and Shanhaiqing (translated from Chinese) colour options. The new handset is powered by Qualcomm’s octa core Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.2GHz. The smartphone also features an Adreno 613 chipset, up to 8GB of RAM, and up to 256GB of storage. It gets a single 13-megapixel rear camera.
title: Vivo Y60 Launched With 6,500mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) shared a series of developments in the cybercrime space on Tuesday. The group highlighted that, currently, artificial intelligence (AI) is being used both as an engine for adversary operations and as a high-value target for attacks. The most concerning development is the first known instance where a threat actor used an AI-developed zero-day exploit.
title: Google Threat Intelligence Group Detects First Known Instance of AI-Developed Zero-Day Exploit in Action

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Find X9s will be launched in India on May 21, the smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. Both smartphones are confirmed to pack batteries with a capacity of more than 7,000mAh, the company has confirmed. This comes soon after the dedicated microsites for the two phones were made live in India on Flipkart, Amazon, and the company’s online store. Moreover, the Oppo Find X9 Ultra and Find X9s will boast Hasselblad-powered rear camera systems. While the Ultra model is expected to boast a circular rear camera module, the Find X9s might sport a square-shaped deco.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra India Launch Date Confirmed; Find X9s to Tag Along: Expected Specifications

description: The Lies of P sequel has entered "full-scale development", Neowiz confirmed in its Q1 FY2026 earnings report. A vertical slice of the sequel is ready. The studio, however, did not confirm a launch window for the game. Neowiz also shared development updates on its other projects.
title: Lies of P Sequel Has Entered 'Full-Scale Development' Stage, Says Neowiz

description: The Punisher: One Last Kill is an upcoming Marvel action special streaming on Disney+ from May 13, 2026. Starring Jon Bernthal, the story follows Frank Castle confronting a violent conspiracy tied to his past through explosive action, emotional conflict, betrayals, and revenge-driven storytelling.
title: The Punisher: One Last Kill Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About This Marvel Special

description: Honor Pad 20 is an upcoming Android tablet from the company. While Honor has yet to announce official pricing or availability details, it has already shared the tablet’s design and some of its main specifications. It will launch in pink, green, and grey colour variants. It sports a 12.1-inch IPS LCD with a 3K resolution and a 16:10 aspect ratio.
title: Honor Pad 20 With 12.1-Inch 3K Display Teased, Snapdragon 7 Gen 3 Chip Confirmed

description: Oppo Reno 16F 5G has reportedly received GCF certification, suggesting its global launch may be approaching. The handset, identified by model number CPH2859, was previously listed on NBTC, TDRA, TÜV, and NBD databases. It is tipped to support 80W fast charging and launch in a 12GB RAM and 512GB storage variant. The Reno 16 series is expected to debut in China with Reno 16, Reno 16 Pro, and Reno 16c models before expanding to international markets in June or July.
title: Oppo Reno 16F 5G Appears on GCF Database Ahead of Anticipated Global Launch

description: Xiaomi 17 Max will launch in China this month, the company announced on Wednesday. The handset is expected to join other models in the flagship lineup, which includes the Xiaomi 17, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max, and the top-of-the-line Xiaomi 17 Ultra. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the brand has teased the upcoming handset's design, along with its display size and colour options. The Xiaomi 17 Max is expected to sit above the standard Xiaomi 17 in the lineup.
title: Xiaomi 17 Max Design, Colour Options Revealed as Company Confirms Launch in May

description: Bitcoin traded near $81,000 on Wednesday as resilient buying activity and institutional participation supported crypto markets despite elevated inflation concerns. Analysts said ETF flows, macro data, and resistance near key levels continue to shape near-term market direction.
title: Bitcoin Price Stabilises Around $81,000 Amidst Robust Investor Demand

description: Garmin has unveiled the Forerunner 70 and Forerunner 170 GPS running smartwatches. Both feature 1.2-inch AMOLED displays, built-in GPS, heart rate tracking, sleep monitoring, and advanced training tools. The Forerunner 170 adds Garmin Pay, extra sensors, and a Music variant with onboard song storage. Battery life is rated at up to 13 days on the Forerunner 70 and 10 days on the Forerunner 170. In the US, they are priced at $249.99 (roughly Rs. 23,900) and $299.99 (roughly Rs. 28,700), respectively. They will launch in India in June 2026.
title: Garmin Forerunner 70, Forerunner 170 Smartwatches Unveiled; India Launch Timeline Confirmed

description: Sony Xperia 1 VIII has been launched in Japan as the successor to the Xperia 1 VII. The latest Xperia model is currently available for pre-order in the country via the company’s online store in Garnet Red, Graphite Black, Iolite Silver, and Native Gold colour options. It is offered in four RAM and storage configurations, with the top-end model featuring 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage. The smartphones get a triple rear camera setup, led by a 48-megapixel primary shooter. It packs a 5,000mAh battery. The handset is powered by a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC.
title: Sony Xperia 1 VIII Launched With 48-Megapixel Rear Cameras, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Spotify has released a new “Spotify 20: Your Party of the Year(s)” feature showing the listening habits of users. It shows the first song streamed, the most-played tracks, the all-time most-played artist, and offers a personalised playlist of the user's top 120 songs over the years. It can be accessed on the Spotify app by searching for " Spotify 20" or "Party of the Year(s)”.
title: Spotify Lets Users Access Recap of Entire Streaming History, Listening Habits

description: Motorola Razr Fold has launched in India as the company's first-ever book-style foldable, a couple of months after it introduced in global markets at the Mobile World Congress (MWC) 2026 in March. The foldable has an 8.1-inch internal display and a 6.6-inch cover screen. It is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset, coupled with up to 16GB of RAM. The Motorola Razr Fold packs a 6,000mAh battery with support for 80W wired fast charging.
title: Motorola Razr Fold Launched in India With Triple 50-Megapixel Cameras, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Smartphone buyers may no longer be prioritising flashy specifications or aggressive launch pricing while purchasing their next device. According to a new study, three factors have emerged: durability, reliability, and affordability, which are increasingly influencing purchasing decisions and long-term brand loyalty. The study suggests that Indian consumers are placing more importance on factors like sustained real-world performance, battery longevity, and dependable after-sales experiences over short-term advantages in hardware.
title: Indian Smartphone Buyers Prioritise Durability, Long-Term Reliability Over Specifications, Study Finds

description: Samsung on Tuesday announced the official rollout of the One UI 9 beta programme. Based on Android 17, the Android skin brings expanded AI-powered tools, deeper customisation options, improved accessibility features, and stronger security protections. There are new creative tools in the Notes app, while Text Spotlight is claimed to make reading easier. The company also confirmed that the stable version of One UI 9 will debut later this year alongside upcoming Galaxy flagship devices.
title: Samsung Announces One UI 9 Beta With Redesigned Quick Panel, New Features in Notes App

description: The Oppo Find N6 has a premium design and a sleek profile. The handset packs a vivid 6.62-inch LTPO OLED cover display and an 8.12-inch OLED main display. The smartphone is powered by the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 processor. Moreover, the device features a quad-camera setup on the rear panel with a 200-megapixel primary sensor. The Oppo Find N6 is powered by a 6,000mAh battery. Check out the review to know more.
title: Oppo Find N6 Review: A Great Foldable That You Might Never Experience
